added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed run's manifest carries no baseline_suite and no after_suite arm (it is a read-only EDDB survey whose tests field reads 'read-only remote survey (no local suite)'), and its run directory holds no base/after gate log, so there are no base/head gate logs to difference. A count that was never taken is not stored as zero.

findings.text: follow-on: the machine-readable OP1 shot list omits E101153 (163.89 m3, disrupted) and E101031 (163.67 m3), the fragment's plasma-volume ranks 4 and 5, while carrying E101030 (152.05 m3), which appears in none of the three ranking tables. The two deliverables of one node therefore disagree on the volume ranking's membership: commit 5550a072 regenerated the HTML volume table but not the JSON, so the machine-readable list the plan calls the node's deliverable is not a superset of the fragment, and the manifest's artifact line ('22 entries each with a reason') does not note it.

follow-on: the beta ranking places E101146 first at flat-top median 0.3264, but that number is a reconstruction artifact of exactly the kind the flat-top-median choice was made to suppress: E101146's whole-shot median beta is 0.0387 (logs/beta2.txt, betamed), its flat-top window is only 0.41 s (1.061-1.474 s), it is disrupted, and beta 0.33 at Ip 0.362 MA is not physical for JT-60SA. The node captions the caveat but still ranks it first and carries 0.3264 in the JSON reason, and the manifest's landing names E100981 (flat-top median 0.087) as the peak-beta shot — contradicting the fragment's own table.

follow-on: the fragment's root element is a bare <section id="jtmm-op1-shot-survey">, carrying neither class="evidence-fragment" nor data-reckon="evidence"/"fragment". Every other bare-section fragment in docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/ carries those attributes (jtmm-selene-deck-converter.html, jtmm-signal-map-test-guards.html, jtmm-convention-entry.html). If the reckon renderer keys section type or wrapper styling on them, this fragment renders as a plain section.

item_verdicts.diff: commit 74c11b08 adds the fragment and a 288-line JSON; 5550a072 regenerates the HTML volume table and formats dates. Both carry conventional subjects with mechanism bodies. The second commit fixed the HTML volume table but left the JSON unchanged, which is where the two deliverables diverged.
item_verdicts.done_when: the node declares a read-only remote survey with no local suite, so its measure is the EDDB re-read reproducing the source table's 228 plasma shots. I reproduced that independently: parsing logs/sweep.txt gives exactly 228 shots with PSRC/calIp peak >= 50000 A, first E100599, and imas-efit docs/jt60sa-shot-candidates.html states 228. The three ranking metrics re-derive from logs/calip2.txt and logs/beta2.txt and match the fragment's table values.
item_verdicts.goal: the clause asks the node to start from imas-efit's 228-shot table without re-characterising it, read only what the table lacks (peak beta from the EDDB FAME category, and the catalogue tools beside eddbreadCatTable), rank the OP1 plasma shots by peak sustained plasma current, peak beta and plasma volume while marking PSRC presence, identify the first JT-60SA plasma, and deliver an identified OP1 shot list with a reason per entry. The fragment carries the tool inventory with the command that read each, first plasma E100599 (2023-10-20, 76.1 kA), and the three rankings with date, peaks, units and PSRC/FAME columns; the JSON carries 22 entries with date, peaks, PSRC/FAME flags and a reason. The clause is met; the shortfall is that the JSON is not a superset of the fragment's volume ranking.
item_verdicts.manifest: records both commits, the read-only survey command with its 228-reproduced result and four log paths, the catalogue-tool inventory with units, and the beta-spike caveat; honest about the raw-versus-flat-top beta distinction. Blemishes: the landing line names E100981 0.087 as the peak-beta shot while the fragment ranks E101146 0.3264, and it reports 22 JSON entries without noting the JSON omits two of the fragment's volume-ranked shots.
item_verdicts.write_paths: both commits touch only docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-op1-shot-survey.html and .json, exactly the manifest's changed_paths and within the figure/fragment fence; the third declared path docs/figures/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-op1-shot-survey is unused, and no plan, sprint, index or other node's file is modified.

justifications.durability: the deliverable is a hand-assembled evidence fragment plus a JSON with no regenerating script, so a later edit cannot reproduce it and the two halves can drift — which happened within the run itself when 5550a072 regenerated the HTML table but not the JSON. The median and tool values are recorded, but the list is not rebuildable from the logs without re-doing the analysis, which is the drift the evidence repository is meant to avoid.
justifications.evidence: the numbers reproduce from the run's own logs (228 shots, the sustained-current plateaus from calip2.txt, the beta flat-top medians from beta2.txt) and the volume ranking head E101017 177.25 m3 matches imas-efit's table exactly; the 228-shot positive control is real. It is held well below full because one ranking's top entry (E101146, beta 0.3264) is an artifact the chosen statistic was meant to reject, and because the fragment and the JSON disagree on the volume ranking's membership.
justifications.fit: the fragment follows the substantive evidence conventions (project-absolute link to the JSON, dates, units, source-per-column, caveats beside the affected ranking), but its root section carries neither class="evidence-fragment" nor data-reckon, unlike every sibling bare-section fragment, and no figure was produced though a figures write path was granted.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node does its clause comprehensively: the tools list names eddbreadCatTable plus four companions with the command that read each (docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-op1-shot-survey.html lines 5-12), the first plasma E100599 76.1 kA is evidential and I confirmed no earlier shot in the range reaches 50 kA from logs/sweep.txt, and the three rankings carry date, peaks, unit and PSRC/FAME presence with a reason per JSON entry. It is held below full because the machine-readable half of the identified list omits two of the five shots the fragment's volume table ranks.
justifications.reuse: read-only and additive: it reuses the existing fragment-plus-JSON convention and adds no module, reader or abstraction; it duplicates no mechanism and retires nothing, so the reuse budget is clean.
justifications.scope_discipline: both commits touch only the two declared fragment paths; the manifest's changed_paths equal the diff, the figure directory is declared but unused, and no plan, sprint or index file is modified.
